response.rationale: Both answers are accurate for the cue. Indonesian generally uses “internasional”; Malaysian standard Malay uses “antarabangsa,” while “internasional” is also recognized as a synonym. The different-common-word relation is acceptable as a primary-form contrast, and no false-friend contrast is needed.
